summary.scope: Original1783-state force/global-field audits and12 native replays, independently recovered1784th direct candidate at unchanged physical budgets

original1783_force_audit.scope: Independently reconstruct original-prefix controls, ground contact and full dynamic balances.
original1783_force_audit.limitations: This checks only the declared original-history prefix, with real ground support and original controls. Complete grasp/lift, spatial/contact/geometry/time convergence, matching rigid feedback and native model/accuracy-cost acceptance remain incomplete. Source native contacts are preintegration while macro states are postintegration; reported same-macro state differences are physical diagnostics, not contact-law equivalence.

original1783_global_fields.scope: Audit every original-history global stress bound and prepare objective resolved-load replays.
original1783_global_fields.limitations: Every saved physical state keeps its global unaveraged nonlinear peak interval and reference hotspot position. Whole-volume Bernstein determinant/numerator bounds use saved wide coordinates; rounded FP64 field bounds and corner rounding differences are separate diagnostics. Computed-field bounds do not measure continuum error. Linear replay uses a consistent-mass fitted material frame; full-inertia versus rigid-relief differences are declared model diagnostics, not native numerical errors or matched rigid/deformable feedback. Only the audited source history is covered. Physical spatial/contact/geometry/time convergence, remaining finite-footprint models and verified warmed costs remain required.

actual_native_replays.scope: Replay independently audited original-history loads through native Quadrants recovery.
actual_native_replays.limitations: This checks the actual native production solve on objective resolved nodal loads at explicit original-history times. Full-inertia and rigid-relief inputs are separate declared problems. It does not establish finite-footprint load-model accuracy, matching rigid/deformable feedback, physical spatial/contact/time convergence or a verified warmed accuracy/cost range.

interior_corner_certificate_checks.scope: Check wide whole-volume certificates against independent interior barycentric stress samples.
interior_corner_certificate_checks.limitations: Barycentric samples independently check the stored Bernstein certificates; sampling alone is not a whole-volume maximum proof. The certificate follows the affine-F determinant and quadratic deviatoric Kirchhoff Bernstein construction. The explicit long-double stress cancellation allowance is recorded separately. This validates computed fields, not continuum/contact accuracy or complete application history.

unchanged_saved_direct_candidate.scope: Recheck an unchanged direct Newton candidate against the original physical acceptance budgets.

attempts.operation: Re-evaluate the saved direct candidate; no Newton or artificial continuation step

unchanged_saved_direct_candidate.limitations: This re-evaluates the unchanged direct fraction-one candidate saved before artificial residual continuation. It does not accept a defect-continuation stage or change the solver's internal target. Original physical1e-9 body/actual-robot/fresh-step gates are enforced separately. Full independent control/force/state auditing and the remaining original history are still required.
